packageRules.description: Match the PDM dependency cooldown (exclude-newer in pyproject.toml), so Renovate never proposes a PyPI release PDM refuses to lock.
Ignore the root compose file, which only holds throwaway services for local testing.
Repositories built on botkit sync their workflows from it, so GitHub Actions updates only land in botkit.

Outside botkit, gather non-major PyPI dependency updates into one weekly pull request to save CI minutes. The title names the packages it upgrades. The Python interpreter is not a PyPI package: requires-python and the Docker image keep their own pull request.

group.commitMessageTopic: {{{groupName}}} ({{#with (distinct (lookupArray upgrades "depName")) as |names|}}{{#each names}}{{#if (or (equals @index 0) (equals @index 1) (equals @index 2) (equals @index 3) (equals @index 4) (equals @index 5))}}{{#if @index}}, {{/if}}{{{this}}}{{/if}}{{/each}}{{#if names.[6]}} and {{add names.length -6}} more{{/if}}{{/with}})
